result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The module's tests pass (`mvn -q -o test` on `codeanalyzer`, no failures). I didn't add a test, and I didn't check the new patterns against sample `.htm`, `.js`, `.xml` or `-gradle.js` files, so the changes are unverified beyond the existing tests.

- **Generated HTML pages:** in the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules, the extension group was `(html|html|xhtml)`. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`.
- **Generated code:** the `<doc>` XML rule and the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule had paths of `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle scripts:** the build-and-deployment rule had `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The content checks (line counts and text patterns) are unchanged, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files still stay out of those scopes.

I noticed one more rule with the same kind of mistake: the JS/CSS source-map rule `.*/[.](css|js)[.]map`. I left it alone because it wasn't one of the four you listed.
